properties.name: proxyma.chromadb.port
properties.description: Port of the ChromaDB the app starts or reaches. 0 (the default) picks a free port at every start.

properties.name: proxyma.access.code
properties.description: The access code every API call needs (PROXYMA_ACCESS_CODE), at least 16 characters. Empty: one is generated on the first start and kept in the data directory's access-code file.

properties.name: proxyma.h2.auto-server
properties.description: H2's AUTO_SERVER mode for the desktop databases, TRUE or FALSE (the default). A development aid: it listens on every interface.

properties.name: proxyma.updates.releases-api-url
properties.description: GitHub Releases API base URL for the public proxyma-releases repository. E.g. https://api.github.com/repos/myorg/proxyma-releases
